anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gradual, large-radius convex curve transitioning from the dorsal cranial region toward the anterior tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Minimal horizontal extension; rostrum is short and thick with a rounded terminus.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow, obtuse indentation at the junction of the melon and the upper rostrum boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Complete absence of a dorsal fin along the visible dorsal ridge; uniform cyan-metallic surface sheen with high-intensity specular highlights.
